critical_findings.section_crosslingual_sachverhalt_better: Sachverhalt (facts, n=359) superior cross-lingual alignment vs Erwaegungen (reasoning, n=510). Sachverhalt cp_64: cross_lang_same_branch=0.282, invariance_gap=0.187. Erwaegungen cp_64: cross_lang_same_branch=0.094, invariance_gap=0.452. Center projection improves both (sachverhalt gap 0.304→0.187, erwaegungen 0.538→0.452). Completed at 1K sample; full density blocked.
critical_findings.linear_hybrid05_concat_scale_dependency: 15-year (91,929): FAILS jurist gate (LangDom=0.8086 PASS, JP=0.4730 FAIL, delta=-0.2465 vs baseline). 19-year (122,015): PASSES both gates (LangDom=0.7784, JP=0.5395) but still below TF-IDF baseline (0.7235). Clear scale dependency confirmed; two-mode tradeoff persists — citation signals dominate jurist preference.
critical_findings.linear_citation_concat_15year_fail: FAILS jurist gate at 91k (JP=0.4805 vs baseline 0.7230, delta=-0.2425). Confirms static concat does not improve over citation baseline at 91k scale.
critical_findings.prod_vs_cv_tradeoff_validated: v8 holdout validation (train-only TF-IDF/SVD): all 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS both gates on true holdout. Leakage impact minimal: LangDom +0.005, JP +0.015-0.020. No significant information leakage from full-corpus SVD fitting.
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_reproduced: Citation/Outcome (TF-IDF hybrids): LangDom~0.48, JP~0.73, CiteIndep~14%. Semantic Embeddings (center_projected): LangDom~0.86, JP~0.36-0.39, CiteIndep~37%. Metric Learning: LangDom~0.58-0.61, JP~0.53-0.61, CiteIndep~34-37%. No single representation dominates all metrics.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_174k_citation_dominanc: TF-IDF citation-based: 4/8 PASS (AUC 0.71-0.74). Text-based: FAIL (AUC ~0.50-0.63). Production default AUC=0.7163. Confirms citation signals recover citation heritage; text signals do not.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: All representations resistance_score ≈ -0.74 to -0.92. Proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate. Consistent across TF-IDF and dense.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_reproduced_regi: 1000-scale: 15-25% purity gain REPRODUCED (4 seeds). 174k fine-grained (213→111 labels): purity ratios 4-10x but NMI decreases on normalized. Different regime at scale — requires separate validation.
critical_findings.v18_coarse_hierarchy_negative: Even at 4-label branch level: best purity 0.65 (linear_citation_concat) < 0.7 threshold. Fundamental hierarchy limitation confirmed for TF-IDF/citation representations.
